text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl isn't looking so<n>good, so I take
her to the infirmary to<n>get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Trainer! I'll be fine after<n>a little bit of
rest.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, where am I? Japan? No... this<n>doesn't look
like the real world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Eek! What is that squishy creature?!<n>It's coming
this way!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Stooop! Don't you know it's bad<n>manners to attack
people without<n>warning?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Communication comes first! Now tell<n>me why you
suddenly attacked me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it doesn't seem to understand<n>human
language. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
How about a little body language?<n>Let's converse
soul to soul!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I get it now. You're feeling<n>upset after having
a fight with your<n>friend, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you can't just take your<n>frustration out
on other people. At<n>times like these, you need open
up<n>and lay your feelings bare!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let it all out! I'll listen to you!<n>We might be
of different species, but<n>there are no barriers
between us!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's share a laugh together as a<n>symbol of our
friendship! Laughter is<n>the language that
transcends all<n>boundaries! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I knew it—overcoming language<n>barriers is easy as
pie! Even different<n>species can understand each
other!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was due to her pleasant<n>dream, but
Seeking the Pearl now<n>appears back to her usual
self!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh no! It seems even angrier than<n>before!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What did I do to upset it so much?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I couldn't get my feelingsacross... My body language just isn'tup to snuff yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's the fault of the bad<n>dream she had, but
Seeking the Pearl<n>is unable to get back to her usual
self.
